app_fee.value: USD 90 per application, paid online by card; the same fee for all applicants.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate School need-based and McNair/PPIA waivers are only for U.S. citizens, permanent residents and undocumented applicants; F-1/J-1 applicants are not eligible.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fee waivers are available to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and undocumented applicants who demonstrate financial need or hardship. | Applicants who expect to hold or currently hold F-1 or J-1 visa status are not eligible for this fee waiver due to federal eligibility requirements.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School does not require the GRE; each program decides (see the program records).
gre_general.quote: The Graduate School does not require the Graduate Record Exam (GRE). Graduate programs determine whether or not to require the GRE for the admissions review process.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 (old scale) or 4.0 (new scale from Jan 21, 2026) minimum; below 92 / 4.5 you must take extra English courses after admission. Some programs set higher minimums.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum Required Score (ELP Not Satisfied) 4.0 80 80 110 6.5 | Recommended Score (ELP Satisfied) 4.5 or higher 92 or higher 92 or higher 125 or higher 7.0 or higher

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 minimum; 7.0 or higher fully satisfies the English requirement without extra courses.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum Required Score (ELP Not Satisfied) 4.0 80 80 110 6.5 | Recommended Score (ELP Satisfied) 4.5 or higher 92 or higher 92 or higher 125 or higher 7.0 or higher

english_waiver.value: An English-medium bachelor's or master's from India can replace the test, but you need official documentation from your institution that all instruction was in English (India is not on the no-documentation list) and you must have studied on or near campus for the whole degree (no remote/online study).
english_waiver.quote: An earned and bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree (or an internationally recognized academic degree at the same level) from an accredited institution for which English was the medium of instruction. | The student must have been in residence on, or in close proximity to, the degree granting campus for the full duration of enrollment | Official documentation from the applicant’s degree-granting institutions verifying that all instruction is in English (as described in the Graduate Admissions page) is required, except for degrees from accredited institutions in the following countries

notes: Admitted students below the recommended English score (TOEFL 92 / 4.5, IELTS 7.0) must take Academic English Program courses. The Graduate School does not offer conditional admission.
